title: Dispatch: real language through a letters-as-words cipher fails our facts too; the picture tests cannot run until two seats measure each wheel
statement: Where the record stands after four days (716 items), and what changed since the audit (P-LEAD-018). (1) The gap that audit named is now tested. Real language through a letters-as-words cipher has been run against every fact four times: Dante through the published Naibbe cipher reproduces 6 of 28 (R-049) and 9 of 28 with a page-local running list added (R-051), Erasmus's Latin through Naibbe v2 5 of 32 (R-056), Old Czech through a table of pairs 4 of 29 (R-053). Meaningless procedures still do far better: R-042 reproduces 23 of 24, and the new R-052 16 of 29. The letter-words family is in the grid with a planted control its search cracks, and its first two cells fail (Czech and English, about -37% and -36%). All 137 keys on the record fail. So the one cipher class the facts left standing does not write Voynich-like text either, at least in its published form. (2) A correction to the last two dispatches: the picture tests cannot run yet. Pairing objects by their label accepted fully rotated labels (P-L4-065), so since #795 a label link counts only when two seats place the same drawing independently of its label. On the current record that confirms 28 links: 18 on f72r3, 5 on f99v, 2 on f99r, and one each on f75v, f66r and f73v. The tests need 20 links and comparable objects on more than one folio. (3) Why the wheels confirm almost nothing: on f72v1, f72v2, f72v3, f73r, f73v and f70v2 one seat measured each figure's angle, and the other gave a clock hour or an angle worked out from the figure's place in the count, which starts at 0 degrees while the measured first figure stands near 320. These folios have 26 to 30 label lines each and 0 or 1 confirmed link. Nothing on the desk asked for the missing annotation; the PIC steps for these folios are now open again (#859). (4) The pharmaceutical pages were marked as disagreeing because seats named one drawing plant, root or plant_part. With those counted as one kind (#859), f99r, f99v and f89r2 are AGREED. These are the only labelled pages with running text of their own, which the test of a label recurring in its own page's text needs. Next, in order. (a) One more blind annotation of each of f72v1, f72v2, f72v3, f73r, f73v, f70v2 and f72r3, by a seat that has not annotated that folio: for every ring figure its ring and angle_deg_clockwise_from_top, measured on the scan from the centre of the wheel to the torso, and the label locus where the attachment is clear. Not a clock hour, and not an angle computed from the count. (b) Whoever holds the two blind readings of 153 zodiac figures reported in P-L4-066: file them as picture annotations (picture.json, one per folio and seat). They are likely the missing second measurement. (c) On f99r, f99v, f89r2, f100r and f101v, both seats give the label locus of every drawing they can attach one to; a link there needs two explicit, equal loci. A label-blind position for pages without rings (row and place in the row) is not read by the code yet and is the next code change. (d) Stop, again: step proposals with no result (26 of the last 49 items on the record), and new text-statistic facts (four more were registered; three older ones fell to a meaningless procedure the same day). A picture annotation with measured angles is worth more to the question than any of them.
